# Server tick rate benchmark thresholds
# Format: key <value_ms>
# Updated by: tests/server_tick_bench --update-thresholds
# Do NOT edit manually: run the benchmark with --update-thresholds
# to regenerate after a refactoring that changes the tick time.
# (values = measured x 1.5, rounded up to 0.1 ms)
#
# 2026.10.20 rebaseline (measured x 1.5 on the slowest GATED CI
# hardware, per the convention above). The original 8.0 / 12.0 values
# were derived from the 16.7 ms 60 Hz frame budget (half / three
# quarters) and assumed the tick runs at ~half a frame on every
# machine. The gate only runs in optimized, non-instrumented builds
# (sanitizer builds use --report-only, see tests/CMakeLists.txt), so
# the thresholds must hold on the slowest such CI hardware:
#   - GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest (2-vCPU shared Xeon, Release/gcc):
#     average 10.162 ms  ->  threshold_ms 15.3
#   - COPR Fedora 45 builder (shared, Release/gcc): p99 21.015 ms
#     (scheduler tail noise on a shared builder; its average is
#     4.395 ms)          ->  p99_ms 31.6
# The gate remains a regression detector: on the slowest gated
# hardware a 2x tick-cost regression fails the average (20.3 > 15.3),
# a 2x tail regression fails the p99 (42 > 31.6), and a 4x
# regression fails both. On faster hardware the tick stays far under
# the frame budget and the run-to-run numbers remain visible in the
# CI log as before.
threshold_ms 15.3
p99_ms 31.6
